summary: This study fabricated Ti3C2Tx/CNT biscrolled MXene (BMX) yarns from LiF/HCl-MILD-delaminated Ti3C2Tx and stacked CNT sheets. The manuscript explicitly identifies BMX yarns containing 69.2, 86.2, 90, and 97.4 wt. % MXene, as well as a neat-CNT control yarn and a biscrolled RuO2/CNT (BRU) reference yarn for asymmetric devices. The headline 97.4 wt. % BMX yarn delivered 3188 mF cm−2, 1083 F cm−3, and 532 F g−1 at 2 mA cm−2 in 3 M H2SO4. Numerical capacitances for the lower-loading BMX variants, the neat CNT yarn, and the BRU yarn were not printed; device-level aYSC values were not assigned to either constituent electrode.
